title: Oyatie Cloud observability and SLO evidence contract for resource parity gates
purpose: Binds every G002 cloud resource contract to OpenTelemetry metadata, OpenSLO authoring requirements, burn-rate evidence windows, event receipts, and hyperscaler gate alignment while preserving metadata-only strict-separation boundaries.

can_claim_now: resource-level observability and SLO evidence requirements are machine-readable
unsupported readiness claims are statically blocked by scripts/tests/cloud_observability_slo_evidence_check.py
cannot_claim_yet: runtime collector or SLO evaluator availability

evidence_vocabulary.dogfood_storage_boundary: future evidence must come from Oyatie-owned telemetry storage, not external hyperscaler consoles or unmanaged tenant systems

telemetry_profile.export_boundary: OTLP export boundary defined for future dogfood observability substrate; no collector runtime is asserted by this artifact.

slo_profile.query_boundary: Queries must run against dogfood telemetry storage and carry a digestible query plus evidence window before any availability, latency, or promotion assertion.

HG-OPS.nonproduction_boundary: progressive delivery gates remain explicit target contracts until dogfood telemetry evidence exists

nonclaims.statement: This artifact does not provide measured SLO, availability, latency, recovery, cost, or burn-rate receipts.
This artifact does not authorize public SLA or public SLO wording for any cloud resource.
This artifact does not implement or prove an OTel collector, SLO evaluator, alerting runtime, dashboard, or promotion runtime.
This artifact does not prove production readiness; it only defines the evidence that later gates must collect.
This artifact does not prove tenant workload readiness or tenant workload safety.
This artifact does not satisfy the hyperscaler-maturity claim gate; it supplies one metadata prerequisite.

doubt_driven_review.risk: The target could be misread as operational proof because it names OpenTelemetry, OpenSLO, and burn-rate gates.
doubt_driven_review.resolution: Every row is target_contract_only or evidence_required, blocked claim families are repeated per resource and category, full HG-OBS/HG-OPS requirement mappings are validated, canonical OpenSLO burn-rate windows are sourced from the local envelope, and regex claim guards reject readiness synonyms.
doubt_driven_review.remaining_gap: Runtime collectors, evaluators, dashboards, alerts, and promotion receipts are future implementation evidence, not part of G005.

source_otel_semconv.note: Pinned to the OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions resource/service registry; legacy deployment.environment is retained only as a compatibility alias and is not the canonical attribute.
